note: Written by the evening check (Claude). Own words, verified facts only, each with its source. Display only: no entry or exit rule reads this file.

market.summary: A flat-to-soft start is signalled after Wall Street fell on Friday (Dow -1.2%) and most of Asia is lower this morning. Oil has eased from last week's highs, which helps a little, but the regime is still RISK-OFF after Friday's heavy mid and small-cap selling, and FPIs remain big sellers for October. IT opens under the shadow of Infosys' guidance cut, whose US ADR fell about 8% on Friday.

points.text: GIFT Nifty about 22,584-22,610 before the open, roughly flat vs Friday's Nifty close of 22,600 (-0.39%); India VIX 16.86 (+7%).
Wall Street Friday close: Dow -1.23% to 52,215, S&P 500 -0.52% to 7,624, Nasdaq -0.21%; US 10-year yield 4.97%.
Asia this morning mixed: Nikkei -0.4% to -0.8%, Kospi -1.3% to -1.6%, Hang Seng +0.7%, Shanghai +0.9%.
Brent eased this morning (reports range from about $110 to $115, down 1.4-6%) after last week's six-month high on West Asia tensions; rupee about 94.93 per dollar.
NSE provisional flows for 23 Oct: FIIs net bought about Rs 888 Cr, DIIs about Rs 3,235 Cr; FPIs have still taken out about Rs 48,056 Cr in October.
Infosys ADR fell about 7.8% in US pre-market on Friday after the FY27 guidance cut to 1-2% (consensus expected about 1.5-2.5%).
Week ahead: US Fed meeting 27-28 Oct, India's September industrial output on 28 Oct, Jio Platforms listing on 28 Oct. No new US tariff step found over the weekend.

market.watch: Whether small and mid caps stabilise after Friday's 2-3% fall, IT's reaction to Infosys, Brent near $110, and the Fed on 28 Oct.

HCLTECH.summary: No new HCLTech filing over the weekend. The news that matters is the sector: Infosys' ADR fell about 8% on Friday after its FY27 guidance cut, and reports note HCLTech had flagged similar demand headwinds, so IT may open weak. The trade is still about +0.85R (close 1,422.20) with a wide cushion to the 1,225.82 stop.

points.text: Infosys ADR -7.8% in Friday's US pre-market to about $12.19 after cutting FY27 constant-currency growth to 1-2%; the report says HCLTech and Wipro had flagged similar headwinds (lower discretionary spending).
Day range about 1,415-1,468; last quote 1,422.20 at 15:30 vs entry 1,331.80 (about +0.85R, +6.8%); stop 1,225.82, +1R 1,437.78 needs a close.
Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1-2% in constant currency (from 1.5-3%) on pricing pressure; profit +6.2% YoY; AI revenue 10.5% of sales; large deals $5.2 bn.
Nifty IT was the day's best sector while mid and small caps fell 2-3%; selling-pressure read on HCLTech stays accumulation (5 vs 3 distribution days).

HCLTECH.watch: An IT sell-off at the open; a close above 1,437.78 (+1R) moves the stop to cost, stop 1,225.82.
